title: Riverdale, New Trier and running away
summary: He explains his schools, getting caught with gin at Riverdale at 12 and leaving New Trier after losing his grandfather.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: That was the [Burkley Irving] band that you played in?
No, that was a band that -- at Riverdale, Riverdale Country School that I went to.
That was before you went to Burkley Irving, is that right?

Well, I went to Burkley Irving twice. I went to -- this was between Burkley Irving things. I went to Burkley Irving once, I was quite young, and then I went to Riverdale Country School, and I wasn't exactly popular with the headmaster there because he -- they had a very pretty waitress there that used to wait on tables and I was caught in her room with a flask of gin.

Yes. I wasn't exactly expelled, but as they say, he who runs away lives to fly another day. And then I went to school for half a year out in New Trier High School, in Chicago. Not really Chicago, it was Indian Hill, which was right next to Winnetka.
What was the name of the school again?
Well, capital N-e-w, capital T-r-i-e-r. It's still there. It's quite a famous old high school.
And you went there how long?

I went there up until the middle of the year, when I went home for Christmas. My family -- we had lost my grandfather, who was the man in the family, and I was -- my aunt and uncle lived out there, so I went out there to go to school, and I never went back. That's when I ran away.
Although I loved them dearly. They were wonderful people and I guess I was pretty happy there.
